source.query:
with max_table as  (
     select MDM_Rawdata_Id,max(MDM_Rawdata_updatetime) as MDM_Rawdata_updatetime from dscc.Email_CityGroup_Person_Mapping_L2 group by MDM_Rawdata_Id
),Data_table as (
   SELECT T1.* FROM dscc.Email_CityGroup_Person_Mapping_L2 T1 
   INNER JOIN max_table T2 ON T1.MDM_Rawdata_Id=T2.MDM_Rawdata_Id AND T1.MDM_Rawdata_updatetime=T2.MDM_Rawdata_updatetime
   where T1.MDM_Rawdata_AcStatus!='D'
)

select * from Data_table
